airspace.zh: 挪威民航局（Luftfartstilsynet）規定：距機場五公里內飛行須取得航管許可；國家公園等自然保護區可能有自己的無人機規定；起降須取得土地所有人同意，飛行前並應查詢NOTAM與管制空域。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: The Norwegian Civil Aviation Authority requires air traffic permission to fly within 5 km of an airport; nature conservation areas such as national parks may have their own drone rules; landowner permission is needed for take-off and landing, and NOTAMs and restricted airspace must be checked. Check the current rules before any real flight.

village.note: Village at the head of the fjord

skageflaa.note: Abandoned mountain farm on a ledge; approximate

knivsflaa.note: Abandoned farm reached by boat; approximate

dalsnibba.note: Mountain viewpoint south of Geiranger; approximate

eagle.note: Hairpin road north of the fjord; approximate

mouth.note: Where the fjord leaves Sunnylvsfjorden; approximate

tagline.zh-Hant: 峭壁上的農家、遊船時代，與2005年的世界遺產
tagline.en: Cliff-ledge farms, the age of cruise ships, and World Heritage in 2005

zh: 峽灣兩側的峭壁上，有幾處廢棄的山中農場。
斯卡格夫洛、克尼夫斯夫洛和布倫貝格，是最多人造訪的幾處。
en: On the cliffs above the fjord stand a few abandoned mountain farms.
Skageflå, Knivsflå and Blomberg are the most visited.

zh: 農家在狹窄的岩棚上，開出小塊田地。
他們靠峽灣的船，和外面的世界往來。
en: Families cleared small fields on narrow rock ledges,
and reached the outside world by boat on the fjord.

zh: 斯卡格夫洛可以從蓋倫格村步行到達。
其他農場，則要搭船才能抵達。
en: Skageflå can be reached on foot from Geiranger;
the others need a boat.

zh: 克尼夫斯夫洛位在七姐妹瀑布附近。
地方團體修復了一些老農舍，讓後人看見山中生活。
en: Knivsflå lies near the Seven Sisters.
A local society has restored some of the old farm buildings.

zh: 這些農場後來陸續被放棄。
岩棚上的田地，又慢慢還給了山。
en: In time the farms were abandoned,
and the ledge fields slowly went back to the mountain.

zh: 蓋倫格村的教堂，是一座八角形的木造教堂。
它立在村子上方，俯瞰著峽灣。
en: Geiranger Church is an octagonal timber church.
It stands above the village, looking down the fjord.

zh: 十九世紀起，遊客開始搭船進入峽灣。
之後，大型郵輪成了蓋倫格最常見的訪客。
en: From the 19th century, visitors began to come into the fjord by boat.
Later, big cruise ships became the commonest visitors to Geiranger.

zh: 蓋倫格與海勒蘇爾特之間，有渡輪航線。
渡輪沿途經過七姐妹瀑布。
en: A ferry runs between Geiranger and Hellesylt,
passing the Seven Sisters on the way.

zh: 公路的開通，讓峽灣不再只靠船對外聯繫。
老鷹之路的十一個髮夾彎，從北岸爬上山。
en: Roads ended the fjord's dependence on boats.
The Eagle Road climbs the north side in eleven hairpins.

zh: 1934年，鄰近的塔峽灣發生山崩海嘯。
十七公尺高的海浪，奪走了41條人命。
en: In 1934 a rockslide tsunami struck the nearby Tafjord.
A wave about 17 metres high killed 41 people.

zh: 這段記憶，讓人們認真看待奧克內斯的裂縫。
2004年，斯特蘭達設立了監測中心。
en: That memory is why Åkernes is taken so seriously.
In 2004 a monitoring centre was set up in Stranda.

zh: 2005年，蓋倫格峽灣與納柔依峽灣一起列入世界遺產。
合稱「挪威西峽灣」。
en: In 2005 the Geirangerfjord and the Nærøyfjord joined the World Heritage List together
as the West Norwegian Fjords.

zh: 2026年1月起，一萬總噸以下的客船，在遺產峽灣內必須零排放。
較大的郵輪，則從2032年起適用。
en: From 1 January 2026, passenger ships under 10,000 gross tons must be zero-emission here.
Larger cruise ships must follow from 2032.

zh: 從崖上的農家、郵輪的時代，到零排放的峽灣，
人們和這片峽灣相處的方式，一直在改變。
en: From cliff-ledge farms and the age of cruise ships to a zero-emission fjord,
the way people live with this fjord keeps changing.

tagline.zh-Hant: 七姐妹與求婚者、山中農家，與從世界來的旅人
tagline.en: Seven sisters and a suitor, mountain farms, and travellers from everywhere

zh: 北岸的七姐妹瀑布，由七道並排的水流組成。
當地傳說，七位姐妹在山上嬉戲。
en: On the north shore, the Seven Sisters are seven streams side by side.
Local legend says seven sisters dance on the mountainside.

zh: 對岸的「求婚者」瀑布，正努力向姐妹們求婚。
他隔著峽灣，始終沒有成功。
en: Across the fjord, the Suitor is forever trying to woo the sisters,
and across the water he never succeeds.

zh: 附近的「新娘面紗」，讓故事更完整。
三道瀑布，被編進同一個傳說。
en: The nearby Bridal Veil completes the tale:
three waterfalls woven into one legend.

zh: 峭壁上的農家，曾在這些岩棚上耕作、放牧。
要到峽灣邊，得沿著陡峭的小路下山。
en: Farm families once tilled and grazed these cliff ledges.
Reaching the fjord meant a steep path down.

zh: 今天，健行客從蓋倫格村走上斯卡格夫洛。
在岩棚上，可以同時看見瀑布和峽灣。
en: Today walkers climb from Geiranger to Skageflå,
where the ledge shows waterfalls and fjord together.

zh: 蓋倫格村只是一個小村，夏天卻擠滿了遊客。
郵輪停在峽灣中，接駁船把乘客送上岸。
en: Geiranger is a small village, yet crowded with visitors in summer.
Cruise ships anchor in the fjord and tenders bring passengers ashore.

zh: 八角形的木造教堂，是村子的地標。
從教堂邊，就能俯瞰整個峽灣口。
en: The octagonal timber church is the village landmark.
From beside it you look straight down the fjord.

zh: 弗呂達爾峽谷的觀景點，是拍攝峽灣的經典角度。
很多旅遊照片，都從這裡拍出。
en: The Flydalsjuvet viewpoint is the classic angle on the fjord.
Countless travel photographs were taken here.

zh: 夏天，遊客開車上達爾斯尼巴。
在約一千五百公尺高處，同時看到雪山與峽灣。
en: In summer, visitors drive up to Dalsnibba,
to see snow peaks and fjord together from about 1,500 metres.

zh: 老鷹之路的觀景彎，是另一個欣賞峽灣的地方。
從這裡俯瞰，就像用老鷹的眼睛看峽灣。
en: The bend on the Eagle Road is another place to take in the fjord,
seen from here as if through an eagle's eyes.

zh: 峽灣另一端的海勒蘇爾特，村中有一道瀑布穿過。
渡輪在這兩個村子之間來回。
en: At the other end, Hellesylt has a waterfall running through the village.
Ferries shuttle between the two villages.

zh: 2026年起，遺產峽灣開始實施零排放規定。
電動或零排放的船，讓峽灣更安靜、更乾淨。
en: From 2026, zero-emission rules began to apply in the World Heritage fjords.
Electric and zero-emission boats make the fjord quieter and cleaner.

zh: 七姐妹與求婚者的故事，還在峽灣上流傳；
只是今天，聽故事的人，來自世界各地。
en: The tale of the Seven Sisters and the Suitor still drifts over the fjord;
only now the listeners come from all over the world.

tagline.zh-Hant: 海水與淡水交會的峽灣，與峭壁上的生命
tagline.en: A fjord where salt meets fresh water, and life on the cliffs

zh: 峽灣裡的水，是從外海灌進來的海水。
山上的融雪與瀑布，又不斷帶進淡水。
en: The water in the fjord is sea water from the open ocean.
Snowmelt and waterfalls keep pouring fresh water in.

zh: 春夏融雪時，瀑布的水量最大。
七姐妹的七道水流，這時最清楚。
en: In spring and early summer, snowmelt makes the falls fullest,
and the seven streams of the Sisters show most clearly.

zh: 陡峭的岩壁上，只有少數植物能紮根。
岩縫與岩棚，是它們的立足點。
en: Few plants can root on such steep rock.
Cracks and ledges are their foothold.

zh: 岩棚上的老農場，曾是放牧牲畜的地方。
放牧停止後，草地慢慢變回灌叢與樹林。
en: The old ledge farms were once grazing land.
Since grazing stopped, meadows have been turning back to scrub and woodland.

zh: 峽灣兩側的山坡下段，長著森林。
愈往上，樹愈少，最後只剩岩石與積雪。
en: Forest clothes the lower slopes on either side.
Higher up the trees thin out, leaving rock and snow.

zh: 達爾斯尼巴一帶，初夏仍有積雪。
從海面到山頂，短短幾公里內，就跨越了好幾種氣候。
en: Around Dalsnibba, snow lingers into early summer.
From sea to summit, a few kilometres span several climates.

zh: 山上的冰河地形，留下許多小湖。
湖水，最後也流向峽灣。
en: Glacial landforms up here hold many small lakes,
whose water also ends up in the fjord.

zh: 蓋倫格河從山上帶來淡水，在村子流進峽灣。
河口一帶，淡水浮在較重的海水上面。
en: The Geirangelva brings fresh water down to the fjord at the village.
At its mouth, fresh water floats on top of the heavier sea water.

zh: 峽灣上空，常有猛禽在山壁的上升氣流裡盤旋。
牠們從高處，俯瞰整片水面。
en: Birds of prey often circle in the updrafts along the walls,
watching the water from high above.

zh: 山也在變。
奧克內斯的裂縫，是峽灣地形仍在活動的證據。
en: The mountains are changing too.
The crack at Åkernes is evidence that the fjord landscape is still active.

zh: 零排放的船，減少了峽灣裡的空氣與噪音汙染。
這對峽灣的生物，也是好消息。
en: Zero-emission boats cut air and noise pollution in the fjord,
good news for the life it holds as well.

zh: 從正上方看，河流、村莊和峽灣，連在一起。
水從雪山流下，最後回到海裡。
en: From straight above, river, village and fjord join up.
Water runs down from the snow and returns to the sea.

zh: 海水、瀑布、峭壁與森林，
蓋倫格峽灣把海與山，放進了同一個畫面。
en: Sea water, waterfalls, cliffs and forest:
the Geirangerfjord fits sea and mountain into a single frame.

title.en: A Sea Inlet Dug by Ice

tagline.zh-Hant: 十五公里長的峽灣、懸谷瀑布，與一座正在裂開的山
tagline.en: A 15-km fjord, waterfalls from hanging valleys, and a mountain that is cracking

zh: 挪威西部的蓋倫格峽灣，長約十五公里。
它從松呂爾文峽灣分出，再往外連到斯圖爾峽灣。
en: Western Norway's Geirangerfjord is about 15 kilometres long.
It branches off the Sunnylvsfjorden, itself a branch of the Storfjorden.

zh: 峽灣兩側是近乎垂直的山壁。
這是冰河時期的冰河，沿著河谷往下挖出的深谷。
en: Near-vertical mountain walls rise on both sides.
Ice Age glaciers carved this trough by deepening an older river valley.

zh: 冰河融化後，海水灌進谷裡，形成峽灣。
所以峽灣是海，而不是湖。
en: When the ice melted, the sea flooded in and made a fjord.
So a fjord is sea, not a lake.

zh: 北岸的七姐妹瀑布，從高處的懸谷落下。
主谷被冰河挖得比支谷深，支流只能從崖上直落。
en: On the north shore, the Seven Sisters fall from a hanging valley.
Ice deepened the main valley more than its side valleys, so the streams spill over the cliffs.

zh: 對岸是「求婚者」瀑布。
附近還有一道「新娘面紗」瀑布。
en: Across the water is the Suitor,
and nearby falls the Bridal Veil.

zh: 新娘面紗從一道岩緣落下。
逆光時，水幕薄得像一層面紗。
en: The Bridal Veil drops over a single rock edge.
With the sun behind it, the water looks as thin as a veil.

zh: 峽灣最內側，蓋倫格河流進海裡。
蓋倫格村，就建在河口的小平地上。
en: At the head of the fjord, the Geirangelva river runs into the sea.
Geiranger village sits on the small flat at its mouth.

zh: 從村子往南，公路沿著山坡爬升。
每升高一段，峽灣就看得更完整。
en: South of the village the road climbs the slope,
and with every bend the fjord opens further.

zh: 達爾斯尼巴觀景台，海拔約一千五百公尺。
從這裡往下看，峽灣像一條細長的藍色彩帶。
en: The Dalsnibba viewpoint stands about 1,500 metres up.
From here the fjord looks like a thin blue ribbon.

zh: 北岸的老鷹之路，有十一個髮夾彎。
公路在陡坡上，一彎一彎地爬上去。
en: On the north side, the Eagle Road climbs in eleven hairpin bends,
zigzagging up the steep slope.

zh: 西北方的奧克內斯山，山體上有一道深約七十公尺的裂縫。
裂縫每年最多擴大約九公分。
en: To the north-west, the mountain at Åkernes has a crack about 70 metres deep.
It widens by as much as 9 centimetres a year.

zh: 如果山體崩落入海，可能引發大海嘯。
海浪大約十分鐘就會到達蓋倫格和海勒蘇爾特。
en: If the rock mass falls into the fjord, it could set off a huge tsunami,
reaching Geiranger and Hellesylt in about ten minutes.

zh: 研究人員用雷射與儀器，日夜監測裂縫。
一旦偵測到加速，就會啟動疏散。
en: Lasers and instruments watch the crack day and night.
If it starts to accelerate, evacuation begins.

zh: 從正上方看，峽灣窄而彎曲。
兩岸山頂與海面的落差，超過一千公尺。
en: From straight above, the fjord is narrow and winding.
The drop from summit to sea exceeds a thousand metres.

zh: 冰河挖谷、海水灌入、瀑布從懸谷落下，
蓋倫格峽灣，是冰與海共同留下的地形。
en: Ice that dug the valley, sea that flooded it, waterfalls from hanging valleys:
the Geirangerfjord is a landscape left by ice and sea together.
